fox.render_offset_note: no offset declared; identity [0,0], not the rabbit offset

constraints: All seated customer actions face front/down; all placement and cleanup face left.
Use front-facing independent tables/chairs for all 20 seats, including simplified bar seats.
Carry sprites contain food/cups; placement sprites require one independent prop.
Customer drinking contains a cup throughout; switch to seated hold before showing the world cup.
All art is copied from v5 without generating or editing pixels.
schema_inconsistencies: Customer drinks use 3 schemas: root frames+durations_ms; root image+hands_foreground_file; or actions.drink.frame_data.
Drink foreground names use both drink_0.png and drink_00.png; use normalized foreground arrays, not guessed formats.
clips.json uses frame_count or frames and pivot or anchor; catalog normalizes these.
Some drink duration_ms fields are total duration 1160; durations_ms and authoritative clips contain per-frame durations.
Seating metadata has pivot, anchor, seat_pivot, and standing_anchor variants; seated pivot is normalized from clips.json.
Rabbit cleanup has top-level collect/wipe and explicit render_offset [-8,0]; fox uses animations.collect/wipe and no declared offset.
Fox pickup is frame 0 end; rabbit pickup is frame 1 start. Both transfer to inventory at frame 3.
Fox cleanup duration is [220,240,260,240] for both clips; rabbit collect [220,220,220,260], wipe [200,220,220,260].
Fox cleanup cloth_origin [13,7], cup_origin [8,14], cup_render_size [16,14] differ from rabbit shared-prop origins.
Fox wipe stain fractions [1,0.45,0,0] are normalized from events; rabbit explicitly uses [1,0.55,0,0].
Some older drinking notes suggest eat/idle at exit; authoritative Chinese README requires seating frame 3.
